results.title: Robot.com Unveils R-dog: A Four-Legged Robotic Platform Designed to Deliver, Advertise, and Engage
results.author: Robot.com
highlights:
Robot.com Unveils R-dog: A Four-Legged Robotic Platform Designed to Deliver, Advertise, and Engage Accessibility Statement Skip Navigation
...
SAN FRANCISCO, Aug. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Robot.com®, the company putting robots to work in the real world, today unveiled R-dog™, its new concept for a four-legged delivery robot built for two distinct and essential roles in robotics: completing the last 100 meters where wheeled robots cannot operate, and turning those same locations into interactive advertising. R-dog will run on REMI, Robot.com's fleet management platform and the physical API layer that integrates, controls, and orchestrates every robot in the company's fleet.
...
The Newest Robot in an Expanding FleetThe R-dog concept joins an expanding portfolio that includes R-kiwi™ for campus delivery, R-cargo™ for industrial and warehouse logistics, R-noid™ for humanoid labor solutions, and R-ads across the fleet. More than 500 robots are currently deployed across the United States, Canada, Dubai, and MENA, having completed more than 2.5 million tasks to date. R-dog launches today as a concept, with commercial deployments in 2027.

results.author: RuntimeWire
highlights:
Robot.com unveils legged delivery robot to push beyond sidewalk limits
...
Robot.com founder Felipe Chavez unveiled R-dog on Tuesday, a four-legged concept robot designed to carry deliveries across stairs, curbs and uneven ground, then earn additional revenue as a mobile advertising screen. Robot.com plans to move the concept into commercial deployments in 2027 through an expanded autonomy partnership with FieldAI, according to the August 11th announcement. (prnewswire.com)

# Robot.com Unveils R-dog for Last-Mile Delivery and OOH Ads

 PR Newswire August 12, 2026 August 12, 2026 0 7 mins 

 Robot.com Brings Robotics to Interactive DOOH Ads 

The last 100 meters of a delivery can be the hardest — and increasingly, it could become an advertising opportunity. Robot.com has unveiled R-dog, a four-legged delivery robot concept designed to navigate stairs, curbs and uneven terrain while doubling as a mobile interactive out-of-home (OOH) advertising platform.
...
The robotics company has unveiled R-dog, a four-legged delivery robot concept designed to handle the final 100 meters of deliveries in environments where conventional wheeled robots can stop short. But the machine has another intended role that makes the announcement particularly relevant to the advertising technology industry: R-dog is being designed as a mobile, interactive out-of-home advertising platform.
